name: Cortello's Riddle
summary: Travelers follow Cortello's second verse across the sea to Kalimdor. Its lines point treasure hunters toward a cave in southwestern Dustwallow Marsh.

sections.title: A Verse Pointing Across the Sea
sections.body: Cortello's second verse sends searchers toward Kalimdor. It describes Dustwallow Marsh, a gloomy wetland east of the Barrens.

sections.title: The Southwest Cavern
sections.body: The riddle points to a clue in a cave in the southwest of the marsh.

sections.title: Where the Verse Leads
sections.body: The verse leads to Bloodfen Burrow, a cave in southwestern Dustwallow Marsh. A musty scroll waits there.

faq.q: Where does this riddle send travelers?
aliases: where is the second riddle clue
faq.answer: The verse sends searchers to Kalimdor, to Dustwallow Marsh east of the Barrens.

faq.q: Where in Dustwallow Marsh is the clue hidden?
aliases: where is the cave in dustwallow
faq.answer: The clue lies in a cave in southwestern Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.q: What item initiates this step of the trail?
faq.answer: This step begins with a soggy scroll found at the end of the first riddle's trail in the Swamp of Sorrows.
